avoid: Tight inner spiral turnings that cause crowding

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Angaze (αγκαζέ) hold: arms linked at the elbows with hands held up high

movement_profile.partnering: Non-partnered group line joined via elbow-hold (angaze)

signature_moves.description: The leading end of the open circle guides the line to wind inward upon itself into a spiral pattern.
signature_moves.name: Snail spiral winding

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Slow and steady continuous winding movement
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking arm connection in the tight spiral formation; miscounting the asymmetrical 3+2 pattern.

music_profile.musical_form: Strophic folk songs with refrain interjections
music_profile.sound_description: Characterized by an asymmetrical 5/4 meter (3+2 breakdown) accompanied by traditional Greek vocal storytelling and instrumental accompaniment, featuring prominent vocal refrains like 'aman aman'.
music_profile.vocal_style: Greek folk vocal style with recurring 'aman aman' refrain interjections

basic_steps: Join hands/arms in high angaze (elbow hook) hold with neighboring dancers
Step laterally along the line maintaining the 5/4 (3+2) rhythmic timing
Follow the lead dancer as the open line winds inward into a spiral snail-shaped formation
teaching.formation: Open circle winding into a snail-shaped spiral
teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination in maintaining an arm-linked open circle while shifting spatial orientation in a tight spiral.
